title: Halcyon Drift Rising Revisited
author: Juniper Montrose
blurb: Petra Hartwell, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
